The '''2015 [[Tippeligaen]]''' was the 71st completed season of top-tier [[Association football|football]] in [[Norway]]. The competition began on 6 April 2015, one week later than in the [[2014 Tippeligaen|previous season]].  A short summer-break in June was scheduled between the rounds played on 12 July and 26 July, and the decisive match was played on 8 November 2015.<ref name=matchdates>{{cite web|title=Hovedterminliste menn 2015|trans-title=Main schedule men's football 2015|url=http://www.fotball.no/Documents/Bilder/NFF/2014/Hovedterminliste%20menn%202015.pdf|website=fotball.no|publisher=[[Football Association of Norway]]|access-date=27 November 2014}}</ref> [[Molde FK|Molde]] were the defending champions. [[Sandefjord Fotball|Sandefjord]], [[Tromsø IL|Tromsø]] and [[Mjøndalen IF Fotball|Mjøndalen]] joined as the promoted clubs from the [[2014 1. divisjon]]. They replaced [[SK Brann|Brann]], [[Sogndal Fotball|Sogndal]] and [[Sandnes Ulf]] who were relegated to the [[2015 1. divisjon]].

==Teams==
The league was contested by 16 teams: the 13 best teams of the 2014 season; the two teams who won direct promotion from the [[2014 1. divisjon]], [[Sandefjord Fotball|Sandefjord]] and [[Tromsø IL|Tromsø]]; and [[Mjøndalen IF Fotball|Mjøndalen]], who won the promotion/relegation play-off finals against [[SK Brann|Brann]].

===Final===

The 14th-placed team, [[IK Start|Start]], took part in a two-legged play-off against [[FK Jerv|Jerv]], the winners of the 2015 1. divisjon [[2015 1. divisjon#Promotion play-offs|promotion play-offs]], to decide who would play in the [[2016 Tippeligaen]].
